risk_summary: The excerpt relies heavily on standard forward-looking-statement disclaimers and a broad, largely non-quantified catalog of external and operational risks. Management presents a modestly positive outlook, but delayed Rail divestiture, inflation, interest-rate exposure, cyclical steel-market conditions, customer credit risk, and secured debt obligations indicate meaningful financial and execution risk.
